source_stability_basis: Google commit message: Bump Emulator to 37.3.10 Stable; source.properties independently verified
notes: Published stable commit 37.3.10 is the selected source; Google publishes the SDK 37.3.10 binary (build 16970787) without a Linux ARM64 package, so no binary equivalence is claimed.
Dependencies were independently resolved from Google branch history at or before the stable commit timestamp; this is a compatibility candidate, not the official release manifest.
Google gfxstream fix a5b0def9cd0f858b3fc9e2fa88a11a6271f46b02 is part of the resolved gfxstream revision; the local backport used for 37.2.12 is no longer applied.
No source version relabeling, development-head substitution, or runtime permission expansion is allowed.
